description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。
description.en: A client-generated token that ensures the idempotence of a request. Make sure that the token is unique for each request. The token can contain only ASCII characters.
